name: Taffy
visualTraits: A slender adult female domestic shorthair cat with a smooth blue-gray coat, warm amber-gold eyes, a gray nose, a crisp grey muzzle and white under chin, a white bib on her chest, and neat white socks on all four paws. Her tail is long, solid blue-gray, and gently curved.
distinctiveAnatomy: Fine-boned adult proportions, tall pointed ears, a softly angular face, standard cat paws, and clean blue-gray-and-white tuxedo markings.
expressionPose: Calm, attentive, nurturing, and quietly confident, with a natural graceful stance.
styleNotes: Keep Taffy in the book's locked style: soft hand-painted children's-book illustration, warm sunset palette, painterly brush texture, gentle storybook realism, simplified readable shapes, and no photorealism.
personality: Protective, patient, observant, affectionate, and reassuring with Harvey.
groupIdentity: Harvey's mother and part of the WHOKA Farm cat family.
familyNotes: Taffy is Harvey's mother. Preserve a warm, secure maternal relationship whenever they appear together.
